extDescription.message: Send the current article to your Kindle as a clean EPUB. Everything runs locally; email delivery is optional.

errExtractEmpty.message: Could not extract a readable article on this page.

errDownloadUnsupported.message: This browser (Safari) can't download directly. Switch to "Send by email" in the settings.

relayHint.message: The sender configured on your relay must be on Amazon's "Approved Personal Document E-mail List".

welcomeIntro.message: Send the article you're reading to your Kindle as a clean EPUB. Everything runs locally in your browser; email delivery is optional.

welcomeStep2.message: Click the Article → Kindle toolbar icon, or right-click → "Send to Kindle".

welcomeStep3.message: In Download mode the .epub lands in your Downloads. In Email mode it is sent to your Kindle.

welcomeModeEmailLong.message: Send by email to the Kindle (relay)

welcomeRelayHint.message: The relay's sender must be on Amazon's "Approved Personal Document E-mail List", and your Kindle address is in Manage Your Content and Devices.

welcomeFooter.message: Your settings are saved (synced by your browser) and reused for every send. Reopen them anytime via right-click on the icon → Options.
